in_marathi.name: Annapoorani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of food and nourishment
in_marathi.long_meaning: Annapoorani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Annapoorani is a revered deity in Hinduism, symbolizing the goddess of food and nourishment. She is often depicted holding a bowl of rice and is believed to bestow prosperity and abundance. The name Annapoorani signifies the giver of food, the sustainer, and the nurturer.
